dedupe_keys.name: seequent solution for tailings storage facilities

description: A commercial cloud and desktop software solution for managing data and models of tailings dams. The Seequent page says it provides a cloud knowledge base that acts as a single source of truth for spatial, environmental, geological and geotechnical data on a tailings storage facility, and supports a near real-time digital twin of the facility that helps the Engineer of Record and the owner track its condition. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): commercial licence (Seequent). Access is paid. Coverage is any facility the user sets up. Caveats: the page is marketing material and does not list data formats or the models included. For simulation it gives a place to hold monitoring data and geotechnical models together, so that stability and seepage analyses can be rerun as rainfall or pore pressure change. A related catalogue record is the Waihi tailings storage facility digital twin case study.
